'''2020 EGP Day 2 Dennis Reinhardt LS He Is The Chosen One''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dennis Reinhardt]] at [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dennis Reinhardt]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance|V8-L-heisthechosenone.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open He Is The Chosen One Reinhardt LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804023225/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
